method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: a man in his 30s travelling alone
setting_basis: All at dawn: a wide stone ghat on the Ganga at Rishikesh in blue dawn light, a pile of visitors' sandals at the top step, a white-sand riverbank with inflatable rafts pulled up, then a hilltop above the valley at first sunrise with the Ganga a pale thread far below and snow peaks on the far horizon. The aarti is shown only as two blurred raised phones and one small lamp flame, never a crowd. No temple, signboard or road sign is shown, and the footage makes no crowd, distance or step-count claim of its own; those are the script's.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.name: ref_man
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of an Indian man in his mid thirties with short black hair and light stubble, in a teal-green zip fleece jacket over a plain grey t-shirt, khaki cotton trousers and brown hiking shoes, a small plain black backpack on both shoulders, standing in soft blue dawn light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_ghat
refs.prompt: A wide stone ghat on the Ganga at Rishikesh in soft blue dawn light: broad pale stone steps going down to a wide, calm green river, thin mist on the water, forested hills on the far bank, no people, no temples, no signs, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_riverbank
refs.prompt: A white-sand riverbank beside the Ganga near Rishikesh in soft blue dawn light: a row of plain red and yellow inflatable rafts pulled up on the sand with paddles resting across them, large smooth boulders at the water's edge, the green river running fast, forested hills beyond, no people, no lettering or logos on the rafts, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_hilltop
refs.prompt: A hilltop above the Ganga valley in Uttarakhand at first sunrise: plain old stone steps ending at a low stone parapet wall, the Ganga a pale winding thread in the valley far below, layered blue hills, a line of snow peaks catching the first gold light on the far horizon, no buildings, no people, photorealistic, no text.

keyframes.name: kf_s2
keyframes.prompt: Insert in blue dawn light: dozens of pairs of plain, unbranded sandals and shoes crowded together on the top stone step of the ghat, left by visitors, the Ganga soft and out of focus beyond, no people in frame.

keyframes.name: kf_s3
keyframes.prompt: Over-the-shoulder from just behind the man in the teal fleece at the same ghat in blue dawn light: two phones held high in the soft, out-of-focus near foreground block most of the river, their screens only a soft glow, only the blurred hands holding them visible; one small aarti lamp flame glows far off at the water's edge.

keyframes.prompt: Wide shot in blue dawn light: a row of plain red and yellow inflatable rafts pulled up on the white-sand riverbank with paddles resting across them, and at the far end of the row the man in the teal fleece sits alone on a boulder, seen from behind, his black backpack on, shoulders slumped, the green river running past.

keyframes.name: kf_s5

en: I went to Rishikesh alone in October for one quiet morning by the Ganga.
But it was peak season, and the weekend brought Delhi's day-trippers.
At the aarti I couldn't see the river for phones.
Everyone had come to raft, and by Sunday I'd had enough.
I was checking trains home when one line stopped me.
NakshIQ pointed to a twenty-five kilometre drive that nobody makes.
So I drove up before dawn and climbed a hundred steps.
At sunrise on Kunjapuri the Ganga lay far below, snow peaks behind, and nobody else came.

Travel intelligence is knowing where the quiet moved to.
NakshIQ.
hi: अक्टूबर में मैं अकेला ऋषिकेश गया था, बस गंगा किनारे एक शांत सुबह के लिए।
पर वो पीक सीज़न था, और वीकेंड पर दिल्ली से एक दिन के लिए घूमने वाले भी आ गए।
आरती में इतने फ़ोन ऊपर उठे थे कि गंगा दिख ही नहीं रही थी।
सब राफ़्टिंग करने आए थे, और रविवार तक मेरा मन भर गया।
मैं घर की ट्रेन देख रहा था, तभी एक लाइन पर नज़र रुक गई।
NakshIQ ने बताया, पच्चीस किलोमीटर दूर एक ड्राइव है जो कोई करता ही नहीं।
तो मैं अँधेरे में ही गाड़ी लेकर ऊपर गया, और सौ सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ा।
सूरज निकला तो कुंजापुरी से गंगा बहुत नीचे दिखी, पीछे बर्फ़ की चोटियाँ, और कोई और नहीं आया।

ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है ये जानना कि सुकून अब कहाँ मिलेगा।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: Rishikesh was packed.|*Where was the quiet?*

shot_notes: Blue dawn light at a wide stone ghat on the Ganga: a man in his 30s stands alone at the top of the steps, seen from behind, one blurred stranger's raised phone filling the near corner between him and the river.

Same ghat in blue dawn light: close on the man's hands holding a phone, its screen turned away from camera, a small packed backpack resting on the stone step beside him, the river out of focus behind.
Blue pre-dawn light: the man drives alone up an empty winding hill road, seen from the back seat over his shoulder, headlights lighting the road ahead, no other cars.
Blue pre-dawn light: the man climbs a long flight of plain stone steps up a hilltop, alone, seen from behind, a small backpack on, no one else on the steps.
Sunrise, wide from behind: the man sits alone on a low stone wall at the hilltop, a river valley far below him with the Ganga a pale winding thread, layered hills beyond.
Sunrise, very wide: a line of snow peaks on the far horizon catching the first light above layered blue hills, the man small and still in the near corner, seen from behind, nobody else in frame.
